name: r3-rain
notes: Scenes R3 G2 RAIN WALK + G3 HER STREET -> NIGHT (research/sprint-0930/scenes-r3/PLAN.md, G23-NOTES.md). Runs right after variant-v2 / r3-station, so the beat numbers are variant-v2's own; escape-win 6 is the wide street beat sequences.json added.

One background per line: v2-rain 1 rain-sidewalk (ref 04, the red umbrella) | 2 rain-alley (ref 01, puddles) | 3 rain-eave (refs 06+07, shelter) | 4 rain-ending (ref 02, drizzle, the sky brightens) | v2-street 2 street-bluehour (ref 16, 7:00 PM) | 5 her-building (ref 03, door 12) | v2-curry 5 curry-street (ref 05, 3:40 afternoon) | escape-win 6 escape-night (ref 15, 8:40 PM, stars).

Each beat replaces its props: the borrowed shots (umbrella / feet inserts over crossing-night, the rack, the street-day timelapse, the zoom-3 closeup, the shop-street closeup, the sunset street-dusk closeup) are gone, so the place itself is the picture. The two time jumps keep a stamp (shot 'stamp' frames the beat's own bg).

rain-fx (fx/rain.js + fx/RainOverlay.jsx): props.rain = heavy | medium | drizzle | stopping drives the streak + screen-glass + wet-GUI overlay (beat 0 crossing heavy, 1 sidewalk heavy + props.umbrella = the umbrella cel over Nanda, props.underUmbrella (beats 2-4; off on beat 1, where she holds the umbrella cel) = the near-lens canopy rim over the top 1/5, 2 alley + 3 eave medium, 4 ending stopping, escape-win 6 drizzle); platform-rain (r3-station) is heavy.
